news_cards.title: **Bihar to become Steel Hub with 51600 Crore Investment**
bullets: **MoU signed with major industrial groups**: Dainik Bhaskar reports that the Bihar government has signed MoUs with major industrial groups to invest 51600 crore rupees in the state.
**51600 Crore investment**: The investment will be made in various sectors including steel, textiles, and nuclear energy.
**Bihar to become Steel Hub**: The investment will make Bihar a major steel hub in the country.

news_cards.title: **Capacity Building of Bihar MLAs and MLCs through AI and Digital Technology**
bullets: **Capacity Building Program**: The Bihar government has launched a capacity building program for MLAs and MLCs through AI and digital technology.
**AI and Digital Technology**: The program will use AI and digital technology to enhance the skills of MLAs and MLCs.
**Capacity Building**: The program aims to build the capacity of MLAs and MLCs to effectively represent their constituencies.

news_cards.title: **Development of Historical Sites in Bodh Gaya, Sultanganj, and Mandar**
bullets: **Scientific Survey**: The Bihar government has decided to conduct a scientific survey of historical sites in Bodh Gaya, Sultanganj, and Mandar.
**Development of Historical Sites**: The survey will help in developing these sites into world-class tourist centers.
**World-Class Tourist Centers**: The development of these sites will make Bihar a major tourist destination.

news_cards.title: **Free Steamboat Ferry Service Launched in Naseriganj-Panapur**
bullets: **Free Steamboat Ferry Service**: The Bihar government has launched a free steamboat ferry service in Naseriganj-Panapur.
**Easy Commute**: The service will make commuting easy for people in the area.
**Boost to Economic Activities**: The service will also boost economic activities in the area.

news_cards.title: **JP Ganga Path to be Developed into a World-Class Project**
bullets: **Development of JP Ganga Path**: The Bihar government has decided to develop JP Ganga Path into a world-class project.
**65 km Ganga Channel**: The project will involve the development of a 65 km long Ganga channel.
**World-Class Project**: The project will make JP Ganga Path a world-class tourist destination.

news_cards.title: **Bihar to become a Hub for Textiles and Nuclear Energy**
bullets: **Investment in Textiles and Nuclear Energy**: The Bihar government has decided to invest in textiles and nuclear energy sectors.

**Bihar to become a Hub**: The investment will make Bihar a major hub for textiles and nuclear energy.

news_cards.title: **Brahmakumaris to Partner with Bihar Government for Anti-Drug Campaign**
bullets: **Partnership with Brahmakumaris**: The Bihar government has decided to partner with Brahmakumaris for an anti-drug campaign.

bullets: **Instructions to Bank Officials**: The Bihar government has given instructions to bank officials to make the bank more effective.

news_cards.title: **5 Family Members Drown in River in Motihari**
bullets: **Tragic Incident**: A tragic incident occurred in Motihari where 5 family members drowned in a river.
**Rescue Operations**: Rescue operations are underway to recover the bodies.
**Investigation**: An investigation has been launched into the incident.

news_cards.title: **LPG Consumers in Bihar to Face Tension**
bullets: **LPG Consumers to Face Tension**: LPG consumers in Bihar are likely to face tension due to a possible disruption in supply.
**16 August Deadline**: Consumers are advised to clear their dues by 16 August to avoid any disruption.
**Impact on Consumers**: The disruption will impact consumers who rely on LPG for cooking.
